#config-version=FGVM64-8.0.1-FW-build0245-260909:opmode=1:vdom=0:user=claude-ro-cli
config system global
    set alias "FGT-VM64-AZA3VW"
    set gui-auto-upgrade-setup-warning disable
    set hostname "fw-01"
    set timezone "America/New_York"
end
config system interface
    edit "port1"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 192.168.1.242 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping https ssh
        set type physical
        set alias "mgmt"
        set snmp-index 1
    next
    edit "port2"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 198.51.100.10 255.255.255.252
        set allowaccess ping
        set type physical
        set alias "outside"
        set lldp-reception enable
        set role wan
        set snmp-index 2
    next
    edit "port3"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 10.0.0.13 255.255.255.252
        set allowaccess ping
        set type physical
        set alias "inside"
        set device-identification enable
        set lldp-transmission enable
        set role lan
        set snmp-index 3
    next
    edit "naf.root"
        set vdom "root"
        set type tunnel
        set src-check disable
        set snmp-index 4
    next
    edit "l2t.root"
        set vdom "root"
        set type tunnel
        set snmp-index 5
    next
    edit "ssl.root"
        set vdom "root"
        set type tunnel
        set alias "Agentless VPN interface"
        set snmp-index 6
    next
    edit "fortilink"
        set vdom "root"
        set fortilink enable
        set ip 10.255.1.1 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping fabric
        set type aggregate
        set lldp-reception enable
        set lldp-transmission enable
        set snmp-index 8
    next
    edit "default-mesh"
        set vdom "root"
        set type vap-switch
        set role lan
        set snmp-index 7
    next
end
config system password-policy
    set status enable
end
config system admin
    edit "claude-ro-cli"
        set vdom "root"
        set trusthost1 192.168.1.0 255.255.255.0
        set accprofile "cli-readonly"
        set password <removed>
    next
end
config log syslogd setting
    set status enable
    set server "192.168.1.230"
    set interface-select-method specify
    set interface "port1"
end
config log memory setting
    set status enable
end
config log disk setting
    set status enable
end
config firewall address
    edit "EMS_ALL_UNKNOWN_CLIENTS"
        set uuid <removed>
        set type dynamic
        set sub-type ems-tag
    next
    edit "EMS_ALL_UNMANAGEABLE_CLIENTS"
        set uuid <removed>
        set type dynamic
        set sub-type ems-tag
    next
    edit "none"
        set uuid <removed>
        set subnet 0.0.0.0 255.255.255.255
    next
    edit "login.microsoftonline.com"
        set uuid <removed>
        set type fqdn
        set fqdn "login.microsoftonline.com"
    next
    edit "login.microsoft.com"
        set uuid <removed>
        set type fqdn
        set fqdn "login.microsoft.com"
    next
    edit "login.windows.net"
        set uuid <removed>
        set type fqdn
        set fqdn "login.windows.net"
    next
    edit "gmail.com"
        set uuid <removed>
        set type fqdn
        set fqdn "gmail.com"
    next
    edit "wildcard.google.com"
        set uuid <removed>
        set type fqdn
        set fqdn "*.google.com"
    next
    edit "wildcard.dropbox.com"
        set uuid <removed>
        set type fqdn
        set fqdn "*.dropbox.com"
    next
    edit "all"
        set uuid <removed>
    next
    edit "FIREWALL_AUTH_PORTAL_ADDRESS"
        set uuid <removed>
    next
    edit "FABRIC_DEVICE"
        set uuid <removed>
        set comment "IPv4 addresses of Fabric Devices."
    next
    edit "SSLVPN_TUNNEL_ADDR1"
        set uuid <removed>
        set type iprange
        set start-ip 10.212.134.200
        set end-ip 10.212.134.210
    next
    edit "port3 address"
        set uuid <removed>
        set type interface-subnet
        set subnet 10.0.0.12 255.255.255.252
        set interface "port3"
    next
    edit "branch1-lan"
        set uuid <removed>
        set subnet 10.110.0.0 255.255.255.0
    next
    edit "hq-edge-rtr-01-lo0"
        set uuid <removed>
        set subnet 10.255.0.1 255.255.255.255
    next
    edit "wan-transit"
        set uuid <removed>
        set subnet 198.51.100.8 255.255.255.252
    next
    edit "gre-tunnel"
        set uuid <removed>
        set subnet 10.0.1.0 255.255.255.252
    next
    edit "internal-10"
        set uuid <removed>
        set comment "All lab-internal 10.x: HQ campus, branch, tunnel, loopbacks (incl. future VLANs)"
        set subnet 10.0.0.0 255.0.0.0
    next
    edit "branch1-lo0"
        set uuid <removed>
        set subnet 10.255.0.9 255.255.255.255
    next
end
config firewall addrgrp
    edit "G Suite"
        set member "gmail.com" "wildcard.google.com"
        set uuid <removed>
    next
    edit "Microsoft Office 365"
        set member "login.microsoftonline.com" "login.microsoft.com" "login.windows.net"
        set uuid <removed>
    next
    edit "wan-side-lab-sources"
        set member "branch1-lan" "hq-edge-rtr-01-lo0" "wan-transit" "gre-tunnel" "branch1-lo0"
        set uuid <removed>
    next
    edit "wan-side-lab-dests"
        set member "branch1-lan" "hq-edge-rtr-01-lo0" "wan-transit" "gre-tunnel" "branch1-lo0"
        set uuid <removed>
    next
end
config vpn ssl settings
    set banned-cipher SHA1 SHA256 SHA384
    set servercert ''
    set port 443
end
config firewall policy
    edit 1
        set name "campus-to-wan-sites"
        set uuid <removed>
        set srcintf "port3"
        set dstintf "port2"
        set action accept
        set srcaddr "internal-10"
        set dstaddr "wan-side-lab-dests"
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set logtraffic all
        set comments "Branch, edge router and tunnel. No NAT: internal addressing end to end."
    next
    edit 2
        set name "campus-to-internet"
        set uuid <removed>
        set srcintf "port3"
        set dstintf "port2"
        set action accept
        set srcaddr "internal-10"
        set dstaddr "internal-10"
        set schedule "always"
        set service "internet-basic"
        set logtraffic all
        set nat enable
        set comments "Internet only (anything NOT internal-10), basic services. NAT to port2 (198.51.100.10)."
        set dstaddr-negate enable
    next
    edit 3
        set name "wan-side-to-campus"
        set uuid <removed>
        set srcintf "port2"
        set dstintf "port3"
        set action accept
        set srcaddr "wan-side-lab-sources"
        set dstaddr "internal-10"
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set logtraffic all
        set comments "Branch users, branch and edge loopbacks, tunnel into campus. No NAT."
    next
end
config firewall local-in-policy
    edit 1
        set uuid <removed>
        set intf "any"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set internet-service-src enable
        set internet-service-src-name "Malicious-Malicious.Server" "Tor-Exit.Node" "Tor-Relay.Node"
        set service "ALL"
        set schedule "always"
    next
end
